title: BinderData
description: JSON Schema for .binder collection and tabletop campaign interchange files

collections.description: Optional card collections for MonsterCards / external app compatibility

_oldbear.description: Private extension block for OldBear data. The '_' prefix designates private app-specific data (analogous to vnd/* MIME types) that other apps should preserve or ignore.

vtt.description: OldBear VTT state: scenes, maps, tokens, props, characters, markers, fog, and custom statuses

brawl.description: OldBear Brawl state: army rosters, units, coherency settings, game rounds, and mission objectives
